description: Whimsical Flying Dragon with iridescent scales, expressive eyes, playful mouth features, and a tail with distinct feathers.

external_feedback.feedback: I inspected the actual PNG. I see long crossing diagonal and near-vertical strokes above a row of circles, with many overlapping circles clustered near the lower middle. These marks do not form a recognizable flying dragon: head, body and wings are visually unclear, and the line network has no legible animal silhouette. The composition is spatially ambiguous despite filling much of the canvas. This is image observation, not a human evaluation.
